Both added in Indegene (+27% since 30 Jun), Gland Pharma (+34%) and Rubicon Research (+20%). Both cut in KEC International (-36%), Aditya Birla Fashion (-32%), Rallis India (-15%) and PTC India (-13%).

Restaurant Brands Asia has a new promoter: Lenexis Foodworks now holds 41.7%, where the earlier promoter held 9.2%. Newly above 1%: Vijay Kedia in Zaggle, Mukul Agrawal in Tega Industries, Dolly Khanna in Rain Industries, Ashish Dhawan in Equitas SFB, Vanaja Iyer in Axiscades. I find XIDA equally interesting as defence, may be even more in future.

Then Aerospace. Cloud Wave acquired, contributed ₹16.5 Cr revenue with 20% EBITDA margin.

Company is trying to move from engineering design to actually manufacturing components.

This is important. Designing something for customer and then supplying same product for years, can change whole economics.

16 new defence orders worth ₹80 Cr. Management talking about ₹730 Cr potential future production from these programmes. But not confirmed order yet.

Now one thing bothering me.

Defence, XIDA, Cloud Wave individually making good margins. But at total group level EBITDA only ₹11.4 Cr.

Why?

Parent company carrying heavy expenses, ESOP ₹12 Cr, and old loss making businesses also eating profits.

AXISCADES is definitely changing into different kind of company.

But at ₹8,200 Cr valuation, market already expecting quite big success.

Business opportunity is real. Investment opportunity at this price, still not so clear to me.

Tata Chemicals paid $22 million for Searles Valley customer contracts covering 0.5 mt over 2 years. Nearby California and Mexico customers mean lower transport costs. Management says pricing is better than its export alternative.

Tata Chemicals is adding:
